steps_h2: How to Make a Garment on Model Photo in 3 Simple Steps
steps_lead: Upload the garment, choose a scene, then download a photo you can check against the real piece before it goes on Shopify.

steps.d: Upload a clear garment photo. Show the collar, how it fastens, the sleeves, pockets, and hem. Flat lay or hanger is fine.
Pick an on-model scene that matches the garment. Ask for another pose, a shirt underneath, or a back view only if needed.
Download the photo and add the real size chart beside it. Check fit and color against the physical piece before you post.

faq.q: What is AI virtual try-on for clothing?
faq.a: Upload a flat-lay or hanger photo and get that garment on a generated person. Use it beside the flat lay on the listing, or in the launch post.

faq.q: How do I get from a hanger photo to an on-model photo?
faq.a: Upload a clear garment photo, choose a fashion scene and download the result. Check shape, color, seams and closures against the physical piece before you publish.

faq.q: Which garments can I start with?
faq.a: Jackets, knitwear, dresses, skirts, shirts and trousers fit when the full garment is in frame. Keep the collar, sleeves, pockets and hem visible in the source.

faq.q: Can I make more than one scene from the same garment?
faq.a: Yes. Run the same photo again for a mirror scene, a walking scene, or a styled catalog scene. A back view needs a photo of the back, or a clear note about the back, and it is a separate run.
Clothing shops, ecommerce teams and agencies that need an on-model photo without booking a model. The person in the frame is generated, not a hired model and not a customer.

faq.q: Do I need a photo studio to use it?
faq.a: No. The path on screen is upload, choose a scene, download. Start with a front or hanger photo and a simple pose.

faq.q: What does a try-on photo cost, and can I use it in ads?
faq.a: Each photo costs 24 credits. Credits are the points that pay for the photo. The cost is shown before you start, and a failed run puts those credits back. The download has no watermark, and you can use it in your own ads, pages, and posts.

faq.q: Can I use the square photo in an Instagram feed?
faq.a: Yes. The same square file can sit in a feed post and on the product page. Notes on where it fits are on [AI Instagram ads](page:plat-instagram).

faq.q: Do I pay before it starts, and do I book a model?
faq.a: The credit cost is on screen before the run starts, and a failed run puts those credits back. You are not booking a model or a studio on this path.

faq.q: Can I add a spoken line and publish the ad?
faq.a: Yes. This template downloads a square on-model photo. Add a spoken line when you build the ad, then publish to TikTok, Instagram, or Facebook. Check the garment against the real piece first.
Yes. API means a connection from your own shop. It can send a garment and bring the finished photo back.
